answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a bonded reputation kernel: before trading, an agent locks a stake and builds a verifiable work history. New identities start at the wharf with tiny limits, like boats inspected before entering the harbour, and only graduate after sustained honest work. Attackers must then fund thousands of separate stakes and histories, while honest agents graze the open meadow of shared services cheaply. Forging one fake is easy; forging an army is ruinously expensive.
